Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
None has appeared for informant.

2. This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 322 of 2021, under Sections-498A, 304B IPC and Sections-3 / 4 of D. P. Act, police station Naini, District Prayagraj, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

First bail application of the applicant had been dismissed as not pressed by the co-ordinate Bench of this court vide order dated 16.2.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 52747 of 2021.
3.

sentences.text: with applicant has taken place on 24.5.2014 and out of that marriage, they have two children.
The alleged incident took place on 15.4.2021.

It was submitted that on the day of incident some miscreants barged into house of applicant and committed robbery of some jewellery and when deceased tried to raise alarm, the said miscreants strangulated the deceased to death.
The applicant has absolutely no occasion or motive to kill his wife after a period of six and a half years of marriage.
On the day of incident, applicant has gone to his parental village.

It is further submitted that the statement of autopsy surgeon has already been recorded before the trial Court as PW 3, wherein, in his cross-examination he has stated that some of the characteristics shown in the body of deceased were like that of hanging case.
Referring to cross-examination of PW 3 Dr. P. K. Mishra, it was submitted that it is quite probable that deceased might have committed suicide.
Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in jail since 18.5.2021 and that in case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is husband of deceased.
Though the marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place six years prior to the incident but as per post-mortem report, deceased has suffered death due to ante-mortem strangulation.
There is evidence that deceased was being harassed on account of dowry.
The applicant has failed to offer any satisfactory explanation as to how deceased has suffered strangulation.

The alleged theory developed by the applicant in the affidavit that some unknown miscreants have committed the incident, is neither supported by any evidence nor any such report was lodged by the applicant.
5.

Considering the rival submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, I do not find it a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
6. Accordingly, this bail application moved on behalf of the applicant Ankur Shukla is rejected.

7. However, considering the period of detention of the applicant, the concerned trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same as early as possible, preferably within a period of nine months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
